description: This file defines the CompositeSerializable class, a keymaster::Serializable that manages multiple serializable objects by pointer, delegating serialization and deserialization to them.

classes.name: CompositeSerializable
classes.description: A class that holds multiple keymaster::Serializable pointers and delegates serialization tasks to them.

methods.name: CompositeSerializable
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object with a vector of keymaster::Serializable pointers.

methods.name: SerializedSize
methods.description: Returns the total size of the serialized data.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the contained serializable objects into a buffer.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes data from a buffer into the contained serializable objects.
